capabilities: Track expiring items with progress bars, days remaining, and cost
Renew items in one click while archiving previous cycles
Show upcoming expiries in timeline and calendar views
Send configurable reminder notifications before expiry
Compute subscription spend and expiry statistics
disambiguation: Not a general task or to-do tracker; it is built around items with an expiry date and renewal lifecycle.
extras: The manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track things that expire or renew, so users juggle outside reminder apps for subscriptions, documents, and licenses.
summary: Expiry tracker that stores expiring items as Markdown notes and offers a dashboard, timeline, calendar, reminders, and one-click renewals.
